cases.answer: The clinical-data ANN achieved 87.08% accuracy, for binary early-stage Alzheimer's risk prediction (Alzheimer's vs no Alzheimer's) using 31 clinical features from 1,200 patients. The MRI CNN achieved 97% accuracy, for classifying MRI scans into four disease stages (mild dementia, moderate dementia, non-dementia, very mild dementia) using 4,876 MRI images.

cases.answer: No independent ADNI or OASIS-3 validation was done. The article lists the absence of external validation with ADNI or OASIS-3 as a limitation and calls it a future step. Both datasets are Kaggle collections (the MRI images derive from OASIS).

OASIS-3, which restricts the generalizability of the findings.

claims.quote:

OASIS-3 represents an essential next step

cases.answer: The TB review (outlier-microbiome-tuberculosis) does not cite any RCT showing AI-assisted precision care outperforms standard care. It says RCTs are still needed to assess whether AI-assisted strategies are superior, equivalent or non-inferior to standard of care.

claims.quote:
randomized controlled trials are
essential to assess whether AI-assisted strategies are superior to,
equivalent to, or non-inferior to current standard-of-care treat-
ments

other_candidates.quote: which demonstrated good usabil ity in routine care settings
other_candidates.why_rejected: A CDSS usability study, not a randomized trial of outcomes versus standard care.

cases.answer: The articles do not report any count of downstream patients with antibiotic-resistant infections linked to the sampled wastewater plants. The wastewater articles are environmental surveys of resistance genes. Searches found no patient infection counts. Only a general statement on exposure to resistant pathogens downstream appears.
